content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at as payment_created, o.created_at as order_created, o.updated_at as order_updated, o.status as order_status FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'captured' AND p.created_at > :now - 300 AND o.status != 'confirmed' LIMIT 10", "why": "Examine the timing between payment capture and order update to see if orders are being fulfilled before confirmation"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Investigating timing of order status changes relative to payment capture to understand confirmation failure."}
